kurz: Chill butter dough before rolling: it does not stick, cuts out cleanly and does not spread in the oven.
bild_im_kopf: Like a chocolate bar in summer: from the fridge it snaps cleanly, warm it bends.
was_passiert: In the fridge the butter in the dough sets firm. At the same time the flour fully absorbs the moisture and what little gluten there is relaxes. If the cut shapes go into the oven cold, the edges set before the butter melts.
warum_wichtig: Warm dough sticks to the rolling pin, the shapes warp and spread during baking.
faustregeln: For sharp outlines: cold biscuits into a hot oven.
schritte: Press the dough flat and chill in film for at least an hour.
If it crumbles, let it soften for 5–10 minutes before rolling.
Roll out between two sheets of baking paper, so no extra flour is needed.
Chill the cut biscuits on the tray for another 10 minutes, then bake.
